en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large group of people, mainly women in traditional folk costumes, standing in a long curved line performing a communal dance outdoors before a crowd of onlookers. Below the photograph there is printed text in French and Greek identifying the scene as a traditional dance in Megara, Greece. There is also a round seal-like emblem and a web address printed near the bottom.
